0.content: The Tatarasuna Mystery is the name for the events at the Mikage Furnace about 400 years ago. A catastrophe at the furnace killed many and left Armory Officer Niwa Hisahide missing; it was widely thought that he had fled in disgrace. That placed responsibility on Inspector Mikoshi Nagamasa, next in rank. Katsuragi offered himself as the one to blame, and Nagamasa, who needed to live to restore the Mikoshi name, struck him down with the Daitatara Nagamasa and threw the blade into the furnace. Nozomu pulled the melted remains out and died of his burns; Kinjiro hid them, with Nozomu's painting of the blade, in the Arsenal.

1.content: The Daitatara Nagamasa was a nagamaki that Nagamasa forged at Tatarasuna with Katsuragi's and Miyazaki's help. The sword was renamed Katsuragikiri Nagamasa after it killed Katsuragi. In the game it survives as a forgeable four-star claymore whose description calls it a heavy, tough blade once made in Tatarasuna.

2.content: The nameless young man whom Katsuragi found in the Shakkei Pavilion went by "Kabukimono", an Inazuman word for an eccentric stranger. Katsuragi covered for his unusual origin with the story of Nazuchi Beach, and the people of Tatarasuna accepted him as a friend. He is the future Scaramouche, later the Wanderer, and the happiest memories of his early life are tied to this town.
